Grok Usage is an unofficial app and is not affiliated with xAI. It does not run a server and it does not see your password. Sign-in opens the official page inside this app. If that page waits too long, the check is cancelled and those cookies are deleted. Saved usage numbers stay on this phone until you sign out.
